scripts.note: Unavoidable throat trigger: test continuous occupancy while idle, not one-shot on_enter. If boss not defeated and full mask clears north of pixel y832 (top of row13): pause damage, walk one cell to safe mark [5,11], close gate [4,14..6,14], frame both actors at intro camera target, play narrative-owned boss_intro. Set intro-seen only when sequence starts. Skip initializes combat identically. Intro-seen flag must never suppress gate/combat restart after a failed attempt.

Stop attacks and disable all damage immediately; disintegration, slow whiteout, remove boss/summons/projectiles/hazards during white, fade back, reopen entrance and east route, commit defeated flag and pending reward together. No Grail reward.

Seal the east border cells plus transition while idle/dialogue/combat/defeat. On victory remove the seal. No ordinary encounter-clear flag can unlock it.

boss.summon_exclusion: At least 3 cells from Dave, portal/arrival reserves and committed thunder refuge; postpone if no legal authored cell.
boss.thunder_rules: Commit markers once, initial warning >=1.0 s; retain a connected unmarked escape strip >=3 cells wide within current camera. No full-floor coverage, offscreen damage, or marked entrance vestibule.
boss.visibility_rule: Fixed 1280x720 follow camera. Aim/impact markers and attacking enemy must be visible before damage; postpone offscreen attacks. Boss closes distance before attacking. No zoom change.
boss.bat_cadence: Attempt capped bat summon once per complete attack cycle; no accumulation past cap.
boss.laser_rule: Visible aim, charge and committed direction; do not combine beam and thunder into a sealed escape strip.
boss.baseline_tuning: 3-5 minute target with normal main-route equipment, no optional gear or grinding; Claude tunes HP/timings in IDE.
